context: A population of a single species in a closed habitat. The growth rate was measured at many times and population densities. Reliable information from a colleague who knows this system (it is correct): the law is a sum of 4 terms. Each term is a constant times one factor, or a constant times a product of two factors that depend on different inputs. In the forms below each c is a different unknown constant. The terms are exactly of these forms: `c*(t)` and `c*(np.sin(c*t))*(1/P)` and `c*(P*np.log(P))` and `c*(np.log(1 + t)**2)*(1/P)`.

target.name: dP_dt
target.meaning: rate of change of the population density

inputs.name: t
inputs.meaning: time since the start of the observations
